title: A photoreal face
goals: Two figures of VALID in the game as files, unchanged, with their licence
A kit that stands a figure in the world's light, its feet on the ground
A few moves on its rig: standing, walking, waving, cheering
A few expressions from its face's shapes, the teeth with the jaw
The library's card shows them, with a row of expressions
One page where all 42 can be seen, for choosing two
Seen on the library's stage on a real GPU
The two favourites chosen; their looks changed (later)
The gate, a photograph of a real smiling face

captions.text: The first two who were not grown here
Beside the photograph, mine was a drawn face.
So I fetched every free library of people and drew each.
VALID looks the most promising so far.
Four of its people are one mesh: 20,951 points, 84 bones.
Ok go for the whole VALID figure.
Then visualize in our character lib with a few rig moves and expressions.
A man and a woman, as their makers gave them.
They walk the Settler's walk and look at whoever looks.
They smile, laugh, speak. A photograph, no.
Seen on a software GPU only. Not yet on the library's stage.
